turns.question: How much of our campaigns' budget was left at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: At the end of September 2026 (each campaign's last snapshot in 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, added up over campaigns), the remaining budget was 4,130.00 EUR. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
